role: Staff Software Engineer, GTM AI Engineering
thesis: GlacierEQ already contains the GTM workflow, agent orchestration, governed MCP/tool, human-approval, bounded-action, evaluation, observability, continuity, and shared-capability layers. Claudification is the role-specific composition of those existing systems.

requirements.role_need: Build and operate autonomous agents across inbound, outbound, pipeline management, and customer engagement.
requirements.claim: Existing GTM workflow primitives plus deterministic orchestration form the implementation substrate for end-to-end motions.
requirements.boundary: Do not claim these systems have operated Anthropic seller or RevOps production traffic.

requirements.role_need: Design approval gates, handoffs, and escalation paths that keep sellers in control.
requirements.claim: Safety Monitor emits explicit ALLOW / CONFIRM / DENY decisions; Operator Administration preserves reviewed outbound authority; sales write workflows require explicit approval.
requirements.proof: Anthropic Safety Monitor canonical promotion c7ab52e0e70a5cd449f9335f90030059d254325f records 153 test executions across Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 with zero reported failures, errors, or skips.
requirements.boundary: Confirmation is not authorization and autonomous scheduled sends remain disabled in the inspected Operator Administration responsibility.

requirements.role_need: Develop agent-behavior eval frameworks and run them in development and production.
requirements.claim: The estate contains behavioral contract testing, adversarial/regression patterns, production-trace replay guidance, deterministic safety tests, and release/evidence gates.
requirements.boundary: Do not claim Anthropic production eval traffic or that every skill test currently passes without an exact-revision receipt.

requirements.role_need: Instrument model/tool calls and connect agent actions to pipeline and revenue.
requirements.claim: APEX carries explicit execution states, immutable receipts, retries, circuit breakers, dead-letter capture, and provider readback; the GTM layer contains pipeline/forecast and analytics primitives.
requirements.boundary: Do not claim measured revenue lift, pipeline attribution, or ROI until bound to authoritative revenue-system data.

requirements.role_need: Ship MCP servers, agent skills, and web applications connected to CRM, communication, and warehouse systems.
requirements.claim: MCP Stack separates registration from execution authority and preserves credential-gated stdio packages; the skill estate contains CRM-specific operating contracts; a role-specific web surface is deployed.
requirements.boundary: The MCP Stack README explicitly does not claim an estate-wide deployed multi-tenant MCP cloud.

requirements.role_need: Set technical direction for how agents are built, evaluated, and operated across the team.
requirements.claim: The estate encodes reusable architecture, capability contracts, evidence-state promotion, execution gates, and common operating patterns across many repositories.
requirements.boundary: Present this as independent technical leadership across GlacierEQ, not prior leadership of Anthropic GTM.

requirements.role_need: Architect shared codebases and conventions for GTM builders.
requirements.claim: The estate already uses shared skills, pipeline contracts, common verification rules, and evidence promotion across a federated codebase.
requirements.boundary: Do not lead with raw repository count; show the shared interfaces and reuse pattern.

requirements.role_need: Work directly with sellers, observe real workflows, and iterate.
requirements.claim: The software contracts are designed around live seller evidence such as CRM records, email, transcripts, meetings, and internal messaging.
requirements.boundary: The dedicated Anthropic customer-discovery packet remains BLOCKED_ON_RETRIEVAL; do not manufacture prior seller discovery that did not occur.

requirements.role_need: Identify repeatable patterns and feed insights back to Product and Engineering.
requirements.claim: The core estate pattern turns one successful workflow into a reusable skill, contract, pipeline stage, or shared control-plane capability.
requirements.boundary: Keep product-feedback claims prospective unless a specific historical feedback artifact is source-backed.

requirements.role_need: Strong Python or TypeScript, production application experience, and SQL fluency.
requirements.claim: Public and private estate surfaces contain Python, TypeScript/Node.js, SQL, Bash, FastAPI, React/Next.js, REST, JSON-RPC, and database/control-plane work.

requirements.role_need: Production LLM experience across context engineering, agents, MCP, tool use, and evals.
requirements.claim: These are recurring first-class architecture concerns in GlacierEQ rather than isolated prompt demos.
requirements.boundary: Do not claim production Claude Agent SDK deployment without a native implementation and receipt.

requirements.role_need: Use evals and transcript analysis to find and fix real LLM-system problems.
requirements.claim: The estate contains transcript-grounded analysis patterns plus deterministic tool-call review and regression verification.
requirements.boundary: Live transcript coverage depends on the connected authoritative transcript source.

requirements.role_need: Navigate ambiguity and ship without a spec, finding simple solutions to complex problems.
requirements.claim: APEX formalizes context recovery, current-state inspection, bounded action, verification, repair, and continuation so ambiguous work can move without silently changing the objective.
requirements.boundary: Avoid governance jargon when the functional mechanism can be shown directly.

requirements.role_need: Experience with CRM, sales engagement, enrichment, conversation intelligence, or close revenue-team work.
requirements.claim: The estate contains first-class GTM-system integration contracts across CRM, enrichment, outreach preparation, and conversation intelligence.
requirements.boundary: This is implementation evidence, not a claim of prior employment inside a revenue organization.

requirements.role_need: Applied ML / experimentation background such as A/B testing, recommendations, or causal analysis.
requirements.claim: The estate contains an evidence-bound longitudinal worker experiment substrate plus experimentation and analytics capabilities.
requirements.boundary: Current proof matrix explicitly caps causal claims: baseline is verified, causal worker improvement remains pending.

demo.first_run: Motions → Outbound → Anthropic · Claudification → Start motion
demo.central_invariant: model output does not silently become external action

prohibited_claims: Anthropic employment, affiliation, endorsement, proprietary access, or internal deployment
Prior ownership of Anthropic seller or RevOps production workflows
Unsupported revenue, pipeline, or ROI attribution
Production Claude Agent SDK deployment without native proof
Real customer discovery where the dedicated packet remains retrieval-blocked
Current test success inherited from historical receipts
